metadata.description: The FlowLeap Plugin Marketplace — curated, free-to-install skill packs for patent and IP work.

plugins.name: flowleap
plugins.description: FlowLeap Patent AI — the complete patent-research skill set for coding and research agents. Data access: EPO CQL and USPTO Lucene patent search, full document data (claims, descriptions, families, legal status), academic and non-patent literature, patent-law references (EPC, MPEP), enriched office-action citations, PATSTAT portfolio analytics. End-to-end recipes: prior-art / novelty search, freedom-to-operate, patent landscape, claim analysis, patent dossiers, literature review, and disposable HTML dashboards with verified numbers and full data provenance. Role personas: patent attorney, IP analyst, researcher, startup founder. Everything runs through the FlowLeap CLI (npm i -g flowleap); skills never hold credentials.
